operator_decision_zh_tw: 114學年度四上自然25份原卷：全部完成逐題科學、KP、圖形及命題品質篩選後，集中整理合格候選，經使用者最後核准才正式入庫；不以108–113年度完成作為114年入庫前提。

criteria: 25 of 25 original paper source positions independently traced
1623 source positions mapped, including 338 archived source nonmatches
All 25 original papers receive complete item-level science screening
Every one of the original 1285 potentially relevant/uncertain source positions has a traceable final screening disposition
Source image, question wording, options, related subparts and KP boundaries reviewed
CORRECTABLE must be corrected and re-reviewed or excluded; HOLD unresolved must be explicitly parked/excluded and cannot pass admission
Do not fabricate source questions from 21 unreconciled printed score points
Preserve exact source PDF binary identities and resolve three legacy SHA holds before corpus-wide final screening declaration
Deduplicate semantically without deleting original source evidence
Record accepted/revised/excluded item lineage and canonical KP coverage
Independently validate final learner-facing answer and explanation
Recreate or clear rights for learner images; verify proportions and A4 two-column output
Produce an operator-reviewable final admission candidate manifest
Require explicit new user approval on the final consolidated 114 candidate list
Only then add approved, individually cleared questions to public draw pool
Run generator/exam selection, answer and print acceptance, browser Pages deployment and readback
Do not silently enlarge the site during Batch03/04 or any remaining science screening

scope_barrier.decision_applies_to: release sequencing and 114 consolidated final operator gate, not suppression of 108–113 source discovery
